column1: # The kick in the hands for every weapon in guns.tsv (one line a blueprint), and what the game's data doesn't say about it. tools/recoilgen.ps1
# reads this with guns.tsv, stances.tsv and unlocks.tsv (the game's own numbers) and writes src/recoilguns.h. Tab separated; lines starting # are notes.
#   name         recoil.txt's "gun <name>" and the logs (letters and digits are what count: "AS Val", "asval" and "as-val" are one)
#   blueprint    the weapon's blueprint, as guns.tsv has it
#   kind         pistol, smg, rifle, mg, shotgun, marksman, bolt, m320, rocket, missile, at4, none (no gun sway: no recoil)
#   body         the draw the mod knows it by, 0 none: skin.cpp kHeldKinds' bodyIndices, gunprofile.h kRifleId and kSmawId, the train
#   size         how back_cm, rise_deg and lift_cm make the kick (one round from rest, two hands at the hip):
#                  anchor    as given: the M416's, which the physics lines are scaled about
#                  recorded  its own recording of the game's kick (design 6, 2.5: build/survey's): back_cm as recorded (its peak at back_ms);
#                            the rise the one that puts the drawn peak, the kick and the drift's answer to the round together (each round
#                            0.95 of its up, the first times its first-shot multiplier, through its own camera spring), at rise_deg, the
#                            recording's peak (at rise_ms): the kick peaks at its class's time, so the drift's share is the one where they peak
#                  pair      a recorded burst pair gap_ms apart (burst_first of a round's kick at once, the rest with the second round):
#                            each round's size is what puts the pair's drawn peaks at the recording's, the back with held fire's push back
#                            from the second round in it, the rise with the drift's answer to both rounds
#                  physics   no recording: design 6's two-hand physics (4.3) in back_cm and rise_deg, made the kick by the square root
#                            about the M416's (anchor x sqrt(back / 1.0 cm), anchor x sqrt(rise / 1.2 deg): the M416's own physics), to 0.1
#                  given     as given (the source says where from)
#                  measured  as given, measured from the game's own kick in the hands (back_ms and rise_ms its peaks there; its timing
#                            the one that draws it nearest: the source says how)
#   timing       the class's timings (design 6, 3.3): pistol back 25 ms 0.8, rise 35 ms 0.8; auto 30 ms 0.75, 50 ms 0.75; heavy 35 ms 0.75,
#                60 ms 0.7; m320 60 ms 0.9, 60 ms 0.9; launcher 40 ms 0.75, 80 ms 0.7; the lift 100 ms 0.7 for all; at4 110 ms 0.75, 80 ms 0.7
#                (its own launch on the roof: the back's peak at 110 ms, build\designs\at4_measured.md 5.4)
#   roll yaw jitter   the two-hand hold's (design 6, 3.4): a long gun 0.9, 0.25, 0.1; a pistol 0.5, 0.1, 0.1
#   burst_first pair_ms   a burst pair's first round's share and its window (design 6, 3.3: the AN-94's 0.3 and 75 ms), else 1 and 0
#   held_cm      held fire's mean push back in its recording (its loop's mean), - none; the table keeps it as a share of one round's back.
#                A gun the game fires one round at a time (its fire logic single or bolt: the game's single-shot clips, no build-up) gets none;
#   default      yes: its kind's row when a gun is known only by its kind
#   source       where this line's numbers come from
